name: Classic Slow Cooker Beef Pot Roast with Potatoes, Carrots & Gravy

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the roast dry with paper towels, then season on all sides with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.59 kg beef chuck roast
1 tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the roast and sear, turning every 2-3 minutes, until browned on all sides. Transfer roast to a plate. (Reserve skillet with cooking juices for later use.)
While the roast is searing, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 stick celery
680 g new potatoes
½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Trim and medium dice celery. Place in a small bowl.
Peel, halve, and medium dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the celery.
Once the roast is done searing, return skillet (with cooking juices) to medium heat. Add celery, onion, garlic, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, 6-8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel, trim, and slice carrots crosswise into 1-inch thick rounds. Place in a 6-quart slow cooker insert, along with whole new potatoes. Set aside.
When the celery and onion are tender, add flour and tomato paste to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring constantly, until veggies are well coated, about 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp all-purpose flour
1 tbsp tomato paste

instructions.primary_message: Add broth to the skillet and stir to combine the gravy. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened slightly, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat and add gravy to the slow cooker.
Add seared roast to the slow cooker, nestling it into the veggies and gravy. Cover and cook until beef is very tender, LOW for 9-10 hours or HIGH for 6-7 hours.
When the roast is done, remove from slow cooker and set aside to rest, about 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, use a slotted spoon to transfer veggies to a serving dish, then loosely cover with aluminum foil to keep warm.
Skim any fat from the surface of the gravy and discard.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Thinly slice roast, arrange on top of the veggies in the serving dish, then sprinkle with parsley. Serve with gravy on the side and enjoy!
